full_name: Maya Doig-Acuña | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Humanities Edna Newman Shapiro, Class of 1936, and Robert Newman Shapiro, Class of 1972, Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Maya Doig-Acuña is a writer, educator, and a PhD candidate in the Department of African and African American Studies at Harvard University. Her research interests include Black diaspora, family history, and migratory narratives in the circum-Caribbean world, and her dissertation draws on Black feminist methods to examine Afro-Caribbean commemorative practice and everyday placemaking between 20th-century Panama and New York City, with a particular focus on Black women’s memory-keeping.
